description: Congo: 22,842 displacements, 18 November - 19 November. According to the the International Federation of the Red Cross (IFRC), 22,842 people were displaced in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire departments between November 18-19, 2025 due to flooding caused by torrential rains and overflowing rivers. International Federation of the Red Cross (IFRC) - 20 November 2025
